sources.notation_normalization: Box_B denotes the base dAlembertian. The returned parsed equation had inconsistent superscript typography on that operator; the surrounding base-operator definition fixes its meaning. For a constant-curvature fiber on TT tensors, Delta_L=-Delta_hat+2nK, hence lambda_L-2(n-1)K=k^2+2K.
